Qwen3.5-9B on the five W2 test splits (1,000 expressions each, the E1 polygon subset); gIoU $\times$100 with 95\% bootstrap CI over expressions (1,000 resamples, as computed by each run). gIoU = mean per-expression IoU. Own box: the model's own box (E1 protocol) as the mask; W1-F: that box plus the default GrabCut candidate (a fixed pipeline, no LLM decision); random / oracle pick: a random / the ground-truth-best of the four tool candidates; W2-a: the frozen model picks a candidate (zero-shot; candidate 1 = W1-F, also submitted when the pick fails to parse); W2-c: LoRA text supervision to propose the box and pick; W2-c + replay: W2-c trained with self-distillation replay (post hoc variant, descriptive). E1 zero-shot polygon: all 1,000 outputs per split fail to parse (strict scoring gives 0). Paired gIoU differences for W2 were not computed in the analysis (see the cIoU table). External baseline LLMSeg (official code, commit f2191e6) driven by the same Qwen3.5-9B, zero-shot, on 300 hash-selected expressions per split (pooled 1,500), with W2-c on the same expressions alongside. Before refinement = after its first two stages; after refinement = its main configuration. Model calls per image (split means): 13.5–14.0 after vs. 2.0 before refinement; W2-c 2. LLMSeg $-$ W2-c: paired bootstrap, 95\%, 1,000 resamples; the pooled LLMSeg and W2-c readings have no CI in the analysis. Data: RUN-0072, RUN-0076, RUN-0078 (LLMSeg comparison computed on CPU, D139).}
